events.description: 1 worker death. Stuttgart, AR. At 7:30 p.m. on December 4, 2018, an employee was repairing the soffit on the covered entry to a hotel. The employee fell from the scaffolding onto the concrete driveway, resulting in brain damage and a broken neck. The employee was killed.

An arc blast from the switch gear occurred, resulting in burns to the employee's body. The electrician sustained fatal burns from a 13,800 Volt switch gear.

events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Wiliam Heath Roofing. Pine Bluff, AR. At 8:30 a.m. on October 05, 2018, an employee was performing roofing work. The roof was set with dew in the morning when they started. The employee slipped off the roof and fell to the wet surface in the parking area, a distance of 17 feet. The original narrative did not mention the use of fall protection but appears that the employee was not using any. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when ejected and run over by farm tractor…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Tlh Farms. England, AR. At 1:30 p.m. on September 5, 2018, an employee was operating a farm tractor when he struck a rice levy and was thrown from it. The employee was run over by the tractor and the back of his head was crushed.

events.title: Employee is engulfed in grain silo and asphyxiates
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Riceland Seed Company. Stuttgart, AR. At 3:00 p.m. on July 20, 2018, an employee observed the grain level in the silo.The employee decided to enter the silo and was engulfed by the grain. He died from asphyxiation.

events.title: Employee is pinned under horse, sustains crushing injuries,…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hays Livestock Auction, Inc. Searcy, AR. At 6:30 p.m. on July 17, 2018, an employee was on a horse. The horse reared which caused the employee to fall off. The horse fell on the employee. The employee was pinned beneath the horse. The employee sustained multiple crushing injuries and died.

Later in the day, the foreman noticed that the employee was not feeling well, and instructed him to get in the work van. About 15 minutes later,the foreman went back to check on Employee #1 and he seem disoriented. The foreman sat the employee down and put ice on his head. The foreman called the main office to report the incident and took Employee #1 to a nearby hospital. Upon arriving at the medical…

events.title: Employee is struck by lightning and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Redstone Construction Group, Llc. Maumelle, AR. At 2:30 p.m. on June 9, 2018, an employee was standing under a tree during a light rain shower. Lightning struck and killed the employee.

events.title: Employee is crushed by scrap winder machine and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Arkansas Steel Warehouse, Inc. Osceola, AR. events.title: Employee is struck and killed by forklift
events.description: 1 worker death. Batesville, AR. At 8:30 p.m. on April 20, 2018, an employee was walking across an aisle when he was struck by a forklift being driven by a coworker. The forklift severely injured the employee's leg when it ran him over and the employee was killed due to excessive bleeding.

events.title: Employee is killed when pinned beneath truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: A & F Enterprises, Inc. Jonesboro, AR. At 2:00 p.m. on March 10, 2018, an employee was pulling the exhaust manifold from a 2003 Tundra truck that was being elevated by a scissor jack. During work,a malfunction occurred, causing the jack to tilt toward the back of the truck. The employee became trapped beneath the truck and suffocated from the weight if the vehicle.

events.title: Truck driver is killed when engulfed by cattle feed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Elrod Truck Service, Llc. Gentry, AR. At 2:30 p.m. on January 17, 2018, an employee was unloading feed from a tractor/trailer rig with a tilting dump bed at a dairy Farm. The feed was frozen to the trailer walls. As the employee was at the back of the trailer with a pitch fork, attempting to free the feed, he became engulfed by the feed when it broke free. As a result, the employee suffered asphyxiation.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by a tree
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: West Tree Service, Inc. Booneville, AR. At 7:00 p.m. on November 30, 2017, Employee #1 was working with a crew, clearingvegetation and trees from the power line. The crew was felling a 28 foot cherry tree with a 22-inch diameter base when the tree spun from its base and fell in the opposite direction of what was anticipated. The tree struck the employee on the right side of his shoulder and head, fracturing his skull and killing him. and killing him.

events.title: Employee is killed when a section of a jib crane fell
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Multi-Craft Contractors, Inc. Fayetteville, AR. At 5:00 p.m. on November 2, 2017, an employee was putting together a jib crane. A section of the jib crane fell on the employee. The employee sustained a crushed upper torso and injuries to the neck resulting in death.

events.title: Employee Falls Into Moving Auger And Dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Powell Feed & Milling, Inc. Siloam Springs, AR. At approximately 4:06 p.m. on September 19, 2017, Employee #1 was sweeping excess ground oat hauls into a receiving pit with a rotating auger. As he worked, he lost his balance and fell into the pit. The rotating parts of the auger struck him and causing multiple injuries that killed him.

events.title: Employee Falls From Elevated Work Platform And Is Killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Little Rock, AR. At approximately 3:30 p.m. on September 18, 2017, Employee #1 was installing a porch header beam. He was standing on and working from a single 2 in. by 12 ft. board. While installing the beam from the elevated work platform, he lost his balance and fell, striking the ground. Employee #1 suffered unspecified injuries in the fall and died.

events.title: Employee grabs live electrical wire and is electrocuted
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Home Brands, Inc. Siloam Springs, AR. At 4:45 p.m. on July 26, 2017, an employee was standing on a pallet approximately 6 feet above ground trying to connect a fan to a hanging electrical cord. The employee grabbed onto a 480v electrical pendent and fell to the ground. The employee was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee collapses and dies suddenly
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Furniture Factory Outlet, Inc. Fort Smith, AR. At 10:45 a.m. on July 16, 2017, an employee was sewing mattress skirts. The employee stood up at the sewing station and collapsed. The employee had suffered a brain aneurism and died.

events.title: Employee has heart attack at work and dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Cargill Meat Solutions Corp. Springdale, AR. At approximately 10:00 a.m. on December 9, 2016, an employee was feeding turkey cuts into the machine that separates them. The employee was later found unconsciousness. The employee died of a heart attack.

events.title: Employee Cuts Head While Falling Through Skylight
events.description: 1 worker death. Little Rock, AR. At 4:15 p.m. on November 10, 2016, an employee was working on the roof when he fell through the skylight. The employee landed on the concrete floor, cut his head, and fractured an unspecified bone.

events.title: Employee killed when struck by a falling object
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Cache Valley Electric Co. Osceola, AR. At 2:50 p.m. on October 4, 2016, an Employee was erecting an electrical pole with a light fixture. The light fixture fell on employee and the employee was killed.

events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: White Logging Company, Llc. Sparkman, AR. At 10:00 a.m. on August 4, 2016, a worker was using a chain saw to cut down a tree when a tree limb fell and struck him on the head. The Worker was killed as a result of compression to his head and neck.

events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Mize Heating And Air, Inc. Newport, AR. At 9:45 a.m. on July 13, 2016, an employee was working for a heating and air conditioning contractor. He was assisting a coworker. He came into contact with exposed energized wiring and he was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee is struck in head and killed by metal conduit that…
events.description: 1 worker death. Pine Bluff, AR. At 11:30 a.m. on May 19, 2016, an employee walked in the vicinity of a flat bed trailer while it was being unloaded by a forklift. Metal conduit fell off the trailer during the unloading process and struck the employee in the head, killing him.

events.title: Worker Dies in Sleep
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Pathfinder, Inc. Jacksonville, AR. At 2:45 a.m. on May 12, 2016, a worker became disoriented while at work. Unable to clock out from work, the worker laid down on a work couch and never woke up. The worker was found dead the next day.

events.title: Employee is killed when lawn mower rolled over
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Land Design, Inc. Little Rock, AR. At 9:00 a.m. on April 1, 2016, an employee was riding a lawn mower on a sloped embankment. The lawn mower slipped 15.8 meters (52 feet) down an embankment and rolled over. The employee ended up underneath the mower. He sustained multiple injuries, and he was killed.

events.title: Employee is pinned between truck and boom and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: B C Main Construction, Inc. Dover, AR. At approximately 11:22 a.m. on March 2, 2016, an employee operating a boom truck was pulling augers horizontally; from the east toward the west from under a highway. The boom separated at its rotation point and struck the employee, pinning him between the truck and boom. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee struck and killed by falling elevator car
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Schindler Elevator Corporation. Little Rock, AR. The employee sustained crushing injuries to the head and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from scissor lift
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Pine Bluff, AR. At 1:20 p.m. on January 15, 2016, Employee #1 was being elevated in a scissor lift to go to the roof to assist with starting the HVAC unit. The employee fell from the scissor lift 21 feet, striking the concrete ground. He suffered multiple head injuries and was killed.

events.title: Worker Drowns in River
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dawson Employment Service, Inc. Blytheville, AR. At 7:55 a.m. on January 9, 2016, a worker was refueling barge pumps when he fell in the river and drowned.

She was riding the lead end of a railroad car as it was being moved into awarehouse. The railcar was too high for the entrance to the warehouse. The top of the railcar struck the awning to the warehouse, and the awning began to collapse. The employee jumped from the lead car to avoid being hit by the falling awning. When she hit the ground, she rolled under the car. Her body was severed. She was killed.

events.title: Employee killed when crushed by trailer
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Wal-Mart Distribution Center # 6866. Paragould, AR. At 11:45 a.m. on August 4, 2015, an employee got out of a truck and walked behind the trailer. The truck rolled back and the employee was crushed between the trailer and the dock. The employee sustained a crushed back and chest and was killed.

events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Claridge Products And Equipment, Inc. Harrison, AR. At 4:30 p.m. on July 31, 2015, Employee #1 was placing aluminum material into a stretcher. The employee's pant leg got caught in the 130 foot rotating drive shaft, that was rotating at 60 turns per minute. The pressure from the turning shaft caused the caught pant leg to sever an artery, killing Employee #1.

events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Sweetser Construction Company, Inc. Fayetteville, AR. At 7:30 p.m. on June 6, 2015, an employee was constructing concrete forms for drop inlets associated with a new storm sewer. The employee became disoriented,collapsed and died from heat stroke.

As Employee #1 was working, the front-end loader made contact against the kiln door that slammed into Employee #1, striking him in the head. Employee #1 suffered blunt force head trauma, including a left side skull fracture and killed.
